controls: Decoder normalization returns structured, content-free failure reports for source validation, process failure, child-reported error, malformed child report, source mutation and timeout.
Failure reports bind expected and observed source hashes where available, partial-output byte count/hash, process return code, safe child error code, stdout digest/count, timeout and elapsed time.
Raw decoder diagnostics are intentionally not retained because they may include source content.
Full-consultation dataset preparation writes decoder-failures.json and preserves original and partial audio files when normalization fails.
The application stores the failure report in the failed ingest job result before removing its untrusted temporary normalized output.
Regression tests cover timeout, child error, malformed child report, dataset sidecar persistence and ingest job result persistence.

limitations: Raw stderr and raw decoder output are not persisted; the report stores bounded hashes and safe error metadata to avoid retaining possible source content.
